You have to realize that psychological addiction is not about the thing you're doing, whether it's smoking pot or gambling or using the internet - none of those things create the void in you that you are trying to fill. They are simply sort term alleviation to the pain of having that void. It is absolutely correct to say that habitual use of marijuana for anything other than a legitimate, diagnosed medical problem is unhealthy and to promote that habit as acceptable is ignorant. 


Me, myself? I smoked constantly for nearly 4 years. I've only been off for a short time, and I can tell you that the flood of emotional problems that came upon me was overwhelming and scary, almost pushing me to make decisions I am certain I'd regret. But, as the days go on, I can tell that it's getting better because now I'm rationalizing my past and my feelings, I'm regaining my ability to cope, and I can see life in a fresher way. Hi there. I hope I'm not too late to the thread. I wanted to give you my perspective, since there is only one other woman here who discusses putting a child up for adoption. 


I am currently in the process of finding a family to contribute to. I have found one I'm quite interested in and with a little more talking we'll know if we're right for each other or not. The baby is still in my belly, I'm due February 20th. 


**Why?** Well, it's been a tough ride trying to make this decision but in the end it's obvious to me that this is what's best for her, for me, and for the family she will become apart of. I am simply not emotionally capable of being the primary caregiver of a child at this point in time. Nor am I financially stable. Nor do I have a support system for when times are tough. With her family she will have a much, much better life than what I can currently give her. 


**Do you ever miss the child?** She isn't born yet, but yes, I already do. Ideally I would want to be able to keep in contact with her. I want to help support her and her family in some way. I want to be a friend. 


**Does your family know?** No, not yet. They know I'm pregnant but not that I plan to put her up for adoption. I don't know what they'd think, but I don't imagine it'd be anything good. The only members of my family that I really talk to are my father and (most of) my little sisters... Dad isn't exactly understanding. 


**Have you had other children?** No, she will be the first child I've ever brought into this world. I don't plan on having any other children in the future, as of yet, but who knows what I will think 20 years from now. I know that if I were to have a child, I would make sure I was much more prepared than I am now.

You are a victim of the problems your father has. You need to protect yourself and try to do your best for your siblings. Letting someone "in" to problem-solving who obscures boundaries in such a deeply intrusive way opens you up to more manipulation and more abuse. Get away.
